facts.text: Lynchburg offers 96-credit abridged bachelor's degrees that allow students to graduate in three years and reduce tuition costs by 25%.

sources.title: MaxImpact Degrees | University of Lynchburg
sources.quote: Save 25% on tuition: Reducing the credit load from 120 to 96 credit hours lowers educational costs. Earn your bachelor's in just three years: Complete your degree in six semesters instead of eight.
